job: List the sections of a long page and follow the reader.
purpose: An "On this page" list beside long reference content. With data-fd-scrollspy a marker follows the scroll and the current item gets aria-current="true". Items are anchors to section ids; data-level="2" indents sub-sections. fd:change fires when the current section changes.
useWhen: A long documentation or reference page has several sections.
People jump to a section and need to know where they are.

avoidWhen.when: The links go to other pages.

avoidWhen.instead: Leave it out; headings are enough.

states.name: current
states.how: aria-current="true" on the item for the section in view

states.name: no match
states.how: data-empty on the marker when no section is active

variants.useWhen: A sub-section, indented under its parent.

parts.role: The heading, such as "On this page".
Holds the items and the marker.
The moving bar beside the current item.
